Evidence caveats

  • 17,598 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.

Evidence caveats

  • 3,648 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.

  • 1,548 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

Evidence caveats

  • 20,496 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.

  • Bring-versus-bench rates are observational and matchup-selected. A negative lift can mean a Pokémon is reserved for the hardest matchups, not that it is intrinsically harmful.

  • 10,554 older or lineage-incompatible Showdown games are shown as legacy context only and are excluded from the evidence grade.
